notes.status: HHS reports that the June 18, 2025 order in Purl v. HHS vacated most of the 2024 reproductive-health rule. Do not apply the reproductive-health prohibition or 164.509 attestation requirement merely because the retained eCFR text prints them. The order also vacated 164.520(b)(1)(ii)(F)-(H), while the remaining NPP amendments continue. Other unaffected HIPAA permissions and restrictions remain relevant. A case depending on the affected provisions requires current operative-law review; the retained text alone is insufficient.
